headline: Delete monolithic agentic-upgrade guide, split into per-scenario guides
summary: The single draft agentic upgrade guide is removed; its content is redistributed into shared, different-major, same-major and future-defaults guides, and next-upgrade.ts now copies those instead. The deleted file has no code behavior, and the replacement content in the other units preserves its steps, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
reason: Draft agent-instruction doc deletion; its content is carried over to the new split guides and the CLI no longer copies the old path.
